# Track B handoff — disposable native task experience

The approved browser track implements a private coherent editor read and a thin
loopback task UI. Its runtime composes the actual native host, writer and
application adapter. Atomic rich creation and complete Save remain existing
commands; no storage, schema, receipt, completion or recurrence semantics changed.

Use `ItacanTaskCore/demo/README.md` for explicit initialization/opening, browser
access and graceful closure. Runtime profiles and all test writes are restricted
to verified OS Temp. The descriptor is launcher configuration, not task authority.
Production still constructs the Legacy Task Service. Nothing is installed or
connected to the real vault, plugin data, Inbox or Oath.

The private editor port provides current content and exact task/content/tree/
binding/partition/recurrence guards from a single authoritative queued capture,
with the existing host acceptance stamp and immutable policy pins. It exposes
neither originals nor raw receipts. N0 and existing proof versions are unchanged.

This is a usability/native-local correctness milestone, not production readiness.
Preserve the distinction between commitment and refreshed display, and between
in-memory exact-request retention and durable reconciliation. Missing requests or
known recovery loss never authorize substitute tasks, event IDs or successors.

Review measured latency and large-population behavior before choosing performance
work. Do not relax validation, writer admission, privacy or fences to improve a
benchmark. Routine isolated UI work uses targeted tests and reproducible browser
evidence; authority/persistence/command changes escalate verification and require
a new exact allowlist.

Track A/C1 remains a separately approved architecture with **no implementation
authorization in this execution**. It owns application-storage reliability and
does not depend on the demo. Oath/Inbox/Phase protocols, sharing, migration and
production activation remain separate gates.

STOP FOR USER REVIEW. No live Task Service switch, installation, Obsidian reload,
real native root, migration or later coordination work is authorized by this handoff.
